# Vaelro LLC

> Custom website design and business automation for small businesses in Waupaca County, Wisconsin.

Vaelro LLC is a web design and automation agency based in Waupaca, WI. We build fast, mobile-first websites and custom automation systems for small businesses across central Wisconsin. Our clients own everything we build: domain, hosting, code, and CMS. Month-to-month support with no lock-in.

## Services

- [Web Design](https://vaelro.co/web-design): Custom websites starting at $500. Fast, mobile-first, client-owned.
- [Business Automation](https://vaelro.co/automation): Custom workflows for scheduling, intake, follow-ups, and reporting.

## About

- [About Vaelro](https://vaelro.co/about): Founded by Owen Lencki and Liam Bloedow, who grew up in Waupaca.
- [AI Workshop Series](https://vaelro.co/workshop): Session 3 of the AI workshop series for Waupaca business owners, Friday, November 6, hosted with the Waupaca Area Chamber of Commerce. Registration is closed.
